question: Under which Article of the Constitution of India can a person go to the Supreme Court for the enforcement of Fundamental Rights?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 32**.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Under Article 32 of the Constitution of India can a person go to the Supreme Court for the enforcement of Fundamental Rights.**
 
• **Article 32:**
 
 
• It gives individuals the right to go to the Supreme Court directly for the enforcement of the rights conferred in **Part III** of the Constitution.
 
• Article 32 gives individuals the Right to Constitutional Remedies.
 
• It gives individuals the right to approach the Supreme Court to seek the enforcement of other fundamental rights recognized under the Constitution.
